correctness.rationale: Equal coordinate words and gcd of all truth numerators with m are term invariants even under global max/min. For distinct coordinate words, unary McNaughton integer-affine peak term h_a takes value 1 at chosen finite truth a/m and 0 at all other chain points, producing coordinate selectors. Global existential quantifier of a selected generator extracts its value as a constant; finite-chain Euclidean truncated subtraction and sum generate all truth constants iff gcd content=1; selector masking reconstructs every target tuple. Möbius inversion over divisors of m counts injections with gcd one and yields the falling-factorial expression. An injected word with a numerator 1 attains minimum rank; union bound over prime factors of fixed m makes primitive-content failure negligible, leaving birthday collision threshold. Independently compared direct generated closure versus formula for nine small (m,n,r) parameter sets, including r=0 and m=1, and checked finite census.
